March 10, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
Neumann Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 351.61% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Neumann Capital Management Llc bought 28,129 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 36,129 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $5.57M, up from 8,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Neumann Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $913.22 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.72% or $3.04 during the last trading session, reaching $179.98. About 32.19M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Jag Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Nvidia Corp (NVDA) by 94.13% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jag Capital Management Llc bought 30,269 shares as the company’s stock rose 26.83% with the market. The institutional investor held 62,425 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $11.16M, up from 32,156 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jag Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Nvidia Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $148.43 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.72% or $4.15 during the last trading session, reaching $245.33. About 12.64 million shares traded. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has risen 212.28% since March 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 195.58% the S&P500.
